svg.title: Duck Pond layout
svg.text: DUCK POND · Duck Pond · 84x54 tiles · road 5 tiles wide
Lap 187 tiles = 23,974 px · about 28 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 10.0 tiles
Dark channel = deep water (full speed). Pale water = shallows (slower). Patches = banks (slowest; hovercraft skim them).
Buoys mark the tight bends. White chevrons = current. Brown wedge = jump ramp. Orange = fizz/boost. Shore = wall.
Gold dashes = Reed Run: 37 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 40 tiles of main channel
Gold dashes = Duck Island: 29 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 23 tiles of main channel
